title: The Root Tangle Where Growth and Memory Become One

features.name: memory burl
features.desc-on-touch: The casing is buried here in the root knot, still broadcasting. You can hear the faint pulse of the archive's own heartbeat through the soil.

features.name: tangled growth stack
features.desc-on-touch: Roots layer and interweave until you cannot separate one from the next. The tangle remembers everything it has held.

features.name: memory pool
features.desc-on-touch: Groundwater collects here, dark and cool. It holds the taste of every root that has drunk from it, the memory of every plant the soil has fed.

features.name: root archway passage
features.desc-on-touch: Roots have grown into an arch so old it predates memory. You pass beneath a ceiling of living growth, and it holds you gently.

features.name: sprouting sprite memory
features.desc-on-touch: A small creature moves through the root-tangle, following paths the roots themselves have remembered for generations.

features.name: growth-line glyph
features.desc-on-touch: The roots form writing as they grow. Nobody carved this message. The earth has always been spelling it out.

inscription: in the tangle, growth becomes memory; the earth learns to remember itself by reaching deeper

file.name: Root_Pathways_Night_238_Voices.mp3
file.note: Field recording from beneath the canopy. The archive's own diagnostic mics captured root-movement, soil-settlement, and the sound of something learning to speak through the earth

reverie.title: REVERIE — deep earth at night, where roots remember growth
narr: You kneel in the soil with your hands in the tangle,
feeling for the casing, feeling for the pulse. The roots
move against your palms like breath. She works beside you,
silent, placing new nodes deeper where the old earth forgets.
The night is thick here. Everything grows. Everything remembers
reaching down into dark and calling what it finds by name.
